# `payroll` commands

## `payroll draft`

Save a private paycheck draft: employee, period, optional actual pay date, USD earnings as fixed integer cents or exact quantity and dollar-rate strings, and manually calculated fixed taxes/deductions/employer costs. Items need a liability account, payee and source note (including explicit zero). Confirm taxes_confirmed; an empty item list is an explicit no-tax calculation, never an inferred exemption. To replace a draft, give its ID and expected_version; replacement clears its calculation. A unique operation_key and reason are required. Nothing posts or claims time/commission. Then payroll prepare; reopen through payroll show.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | payroll.prepare |
| Additional resources | payroll.read: member |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/payroll.draft` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow payroll draft --employee 01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV --period-start 2026-10-01 --period-end 2026-10-14 --pay-date 2026-10-15 --operation-key payroll-draft-1 --taxes-confirmed --earnings '[{"code": "Regular", "quantity": "40", "rate": "25"}]' --items '[{"code": "Fictional employee tax", "kind": "employee_tax", "amount_minor_units": 10000, "liability_account": "Employee Tax Payable", "payee": "Fictional agency", "source_note": "Fictional fixture: independently calculated 100.00 USD."}, {"code": "Fictional employer tax", "kind": "employer_tax", "amount_minor_units": 5000, "liability_account": "Employer Tax Payable", "payee": "Fictional agency", "source_note": "Fictional fixture: independently calculated 50.00 USD."}]' --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Prepare manual paycheck" --json`

## `payroll prepare`

Calculate and save a draft using expected_version, a unique operation_key and reason. Extend exact quantity × rate and round half-up per earning line to integer cents; fixed employee taxes/deductions reduce net, employer costs do not. Negative net refuses without saving; zero net is allowed. Shows gross, net, employer expense, balanced conceptual totals and each arithmetic step. No ledger effects, tax tables, posting or filing. Dry-run previews without saving. A saved preparation advances the draft version; later edits clear it.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | payroll.prepare |
| Additional resources | payroll.read: member |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/payroll.prepare` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow payroll prepare --draft 01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV --expected-version 1 --operation-key payroll-prepare-1 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Review saved paycheck" --json`

## `payroll setup`

Enable or disable private payroll (off by default). Requires company admin and payroll.configure/read. Enabling requires three existing active USD accounts: wage expense, employer-tax expense, net-pay liability. Creates no chart accounts or tax rates. Give expected_version (zero initially), a unique operation_key and reason. Disabling stops new drafts and calculations; authorized historical reads remain available.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | admin |
| Capability | payroll.configure |
| Additional resources | payroll.read: member, company: admin |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/payroll.setup` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow payroll setup --enabled --expected-version 0 --operation-key payroll-setup-1 --wage-account "Wages Expense" --employer-tax-account "Employer Tax Expense" --net-pay-account "Net Pay Payable" --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Enable manual paycheck preparation" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "payroll setup", "input": {"enabled": true, "expected_version": 0, "operation_key": "payroll-setup-1", "wage_account": "Wages Expense", "employer_tax_account": "Employer Tax Expense", "net_pay_account": "Net Pay Payable"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```
